# uptimekuma_notification_pagerduty (Resource)

PagerDuty notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_pagerduty" "example" {
  name            = "Production Alerts"
  is_active       = true
  integration_url = "https://events.pagerduty.com/integration/YOUR_INTEGRATION_ID/enqueue"
  integration_key = "YOUR_PAGERDUTY_KEY"
  priority        = "high"
  auto_resolve    = "resolved"
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: integration_url_wo and integration_key_wo
# are never stored in plan or state. Change the matching *_wo_version whenever a
# secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_pagerduty" "write_only" {
  name = "PagerDuty with write-only secrets"

  integration_url_wo         = "https://events.pagerduty.com/integration/YOUR_INTEGRATION_ID/enqueue"
  integration_url_wo_version = "1"
  integration_key_wo         = "your-pagerduty-integration-key"
  integration_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `auto_resolve` (String) Auto-resolve incidents
- `integration_key` (String, Sensitive) PagerDuty integration key. Stored in state; use `integration_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `integration_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) PagerDuty integration key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `integration_key`; requires `integration_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `integration_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `integration_key` until the next apply with `integration_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `integration_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `integration_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `integration_key_wo`.
- `integration_url` (String, Sensitive) PagerDuty integration URL. Stored in state; use `integration_url_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `integration_url_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) PagerDuty integration URL, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `integration_url`; requires `integration_url_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `integration_url_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `integration_url` until the next apply with `integration_url_wo` set removes it from state.
- `integration_url_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `integration_url_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `integration_url_wo`.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `priority` (String) PagerDuty incident priority

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
